title: Plant and Animal Cell Structure
text: Both plant and animal cells have a nucleus, cytoplasm, and cell membrane. Plant cells additionally have a cell wall, chloroplasts (for photosynthesis), and a large central vacuole.

title: Photosynthesis
text: Photosynthesis is the process by which plants convert carbon dioxide and water into glucose and oxygen, using light energy captured by chlorophyll: 6CO2 + 6H2O + light energy -> C6H12O6 + 6O2.

title: Cellular Respiration
text: Respiration releases energy from glucose: C6H12O6 + 6O2 -> 6CO2 + 6H2O + energy. It happens continuously in all living cells, unlike photosynthesis which only happens in plants in light.

title: DNA and Genes
text: DNA is the molecule that carries genetic information, organized into genes located on chromosomes. Genes determine inherited traits and are passed from parents to offspring.

title: Mendelian Inheritance
text: Dominant alleles mask recessive alleles when both are present (heterozygous). A recessive trait only shows when both inherited alleles are recessive (homozygous recessive).

title: The Circulatory System
text: The heart pumps blood through arteries (carrying blood away from the heart), veins (carrying blood back), and capillaries (where exchange with tissues happens), circulating oxygen and nutrients around the body.

title: Ecosystems and Food Chains
text: A food chain shows energy flow: producers (plants) are eaten by primary consumers (herbivores), which are eaten by secondary consumers (carnivores). Energy decreases at each level of the chain.
